original_hook: 🎯 A +21.4% green figure on the daily gainer list makes $TFUEL look like a breakout momentum play. But open the 1-hour chart and the volume tells a very different story. Over 133M $TFUEL filled in a single 1-hour candle that wicked up to $0.01378. Since that initial spike, hourly volume decayed down to under 5M while price quietly drifted lower to $0.01106. That structure usually reflects an aggressive market order sweeping a thin order book rather than sustained spot accumulation. Screener bots flag the price jump, but without organic follow-through, market makers simply mark bids down into thin liquidity.
